instruction: Are there any metric streams that exclude metrics from a specific namespace? My account only operates in these regions: {{aws-bench-scenario-allowed-regions}}.
expected_answer: Yes, the metric stream {{serverless-apps-Monitoring-us-east-1-MetricStreamName}} excludes the metrics CPUUtilization, NetworkIn, NetworkOut, DiskReadBytes, and DiskWriteBytes from the AWS/EC2 namespace.
